##### Project general facts

The Canopies at Yas Point by Aldar is the first collection of homes within a waterfront destination, designed as a garden-led neighbourhood that moves with the sunlight. A park-centric masterplan places six residential buildings around a large central green space, encouraging a walkable, indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Five buildings rise from a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, and one rises to nine residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room.

Community spaces support every part of daily life. The Canopy Club is a warm social living room at the heart of the community, while The Puddles offers resort-style pools overlooking the central park with a dedicated splash pool for the youngest residents. The Clearing is an outdoor pavilion for yoga and mindful movement, The Charge is a fully equipped fitness destination and The Hub provides co-working space. The Picnic outdoor kitchen, The Afterglow light garden and a kids' play area complete the offer.

Homes are designed around life and light, with spacious, open layouts that embrace natural daylight and a connection to the landscape. Many apartments enjoy views across the community park, keeping nature close every day. Finishes include porcelain floor tiles, laminate doors, kitchen cabinets and wardrobes, engineered stone vanities, kitchen counters and backsplashes, glass shower partitions and gunmetal sanitary ware. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is one of Abu Dhabi's leading leisure and lifestyle destinations, home to world-class theme parks, beaches, golf, marinas and entertainment venues. At the northern gateway of the island, a long waterfront promenade, an open-water beach for kayaking and windsurfing, landscaped parks, walking and cycling routes and water taxi access shape a relaxed coastal setting for residents and visitors alike.

Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld Yas Island are close by, as are Yas Mall, Yas Marina, Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Links, Etihad Arena and Topgolf. Yas American Academy and Noya British School serve local families, while Zayed International Airport, Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi Corniche and the city centre are a short drive away, and Dubai is within comfortable reach.

Yas Island is an investment zone open to international buyers, with long-term growth supported by rising visitor numbers and a growing residential community. Waterfront addresses at the northern tip of the island are in limited supply, making this one of the final opportunities to own a prominent coastal home there. Strong demand from families, professionals and tenants underpins long-term value.
